name: tour-ceylon-frontend
description: Run Travel + Tourist SOS + Police + Wellness frontends together

scripts.dev: node scripts/free-dev-ports.js && concurrently -n travel,tourist,police,wellness,livedata -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green,blue "npm run dev --prefix travel" "npm run dev --prefix tourist" "npm run dev --prefix police" "npm run dev --prefix wellness" "npm run dev --prefix livedata"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix travel && npm install --prefix tourist && npm install --prefix police && npm install --prefix wellness && npm install --prefix livedata
